name: Dialog
blurb: A modal window that holds focus until it is dismissed.
mechanism: Native `<dialog>` with showModal(): focus trapping, Escape to close, inert background and the top layer, all from the platform. A form with method="dialog" closes it without script.
caveats: showModal() is one line of JavaScript; a :target or checkbox modal avoids it but loses the focus trap and the inert background, which is the whole point.
Give the dialog an accessible name (aria-labelledby pointing at its heading) - it has none by default.
